title: Staying Healthy and Happy

standard_text: Good habits for a healthy body: cleanliness, exercise, sleep and food; feelings and staying happy; safety at home, on the road and at play; simple first aid (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 9).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 3 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 9: healthy and unhealthy habits, cleanliness, exercise and sleep, feelings, safety rules and simple first aid. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Good habits keep us healthy and happy.
body_html:
How to think about it

We stay healthy by brushing twice a day, washing hands with soap, bathing, cutting nails, eating fruits and vegetables, drinking water, playing outdoors and sleeping early. Being happy is also part of being healthy: we can share our feelings and help others.

Safety rules protect us: look both ways at the zebra crossing, wear a helmet when cycling, never go with strangers and never touch bare wires. For a small cut, wash it with clean water and cover it with a clean bandage.

Example

Bed at 9 p.m., up at 6 a.m. Hours of sleep?

3 hours to midnight + 6 hours

Answer: 9 hours

Example

Biting nails is…

germs go into the mouth

Answer: an unhealthy habit

Common mistakes

  • Thinking health is only about the body.
  • Crossing the road without looking.
  • Rubbing an eye that has dust in it.
